    Spotlight: Top Australian CRE News story of the week

    Carve up of $13bn development empire underway as executive directors split

    The directors in charge of one of the country's biggest private developers have liquidated more than $250m of assets as they prepare to go their separate ways.

     

    After nearly 20 years building one of Australia’s largest private land developers, Villawood Properties’ founder Rory Costelloe and executive director Tony Johnson are parting ways, Green Street News can reveal.

    Picture: Property industry stalwarts Rory Costelloe and Tony Johnson (Photo: Villawood Properties)
